cat > project.yml <<'EOF'
name: BlueskyTap
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.example.bskytest
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "16.0"
targets:
  TapApp:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - App
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.bskytest.app
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
      CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
  TapUITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - UITests
    dependencies:
      - target: TapApp
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.bskytest.uitests
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
      TEST_TARGET_NAME: TapApp
      CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
schemes:
  BlueskyTap:
    build:
      targets:
        TapApp: all
        TapUITests: [test]
    test:
      targets:
        - TapUITests
EOF
cat > App/App.swift <<'EOF'
import SwiftUI

@main
struct TapApp: App {
    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            Text("Test runner host")
        }
    }
}
EOF
cat > UITests/TapUITests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest

final class TapUITests: XCTestCase {
    func testTapFirstPostMoreOptions() {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "xyz.blueskyweb.app")
        app.activate()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.wait(for: .runningForeground, timeout: 15))
        let more = app.buttons.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS[c] 'more' OR label CONTAINS[c] 'options'")).firstMatch
        if more.waitForExistence(timeout: 5) {
            more.tap()
        } else {
            app.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.925, dy: 0.705)).tap()
        }
    }
}
EOF
